notes.title: Language Update + 50% discount!
notes.content:
Hello there BUTCHER fans!

It's been quite some time since the last update, so we decided to let you know about 2 things that have been recently going on with BUTCHER.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26094784/cf50d0a6210bf1403bb1bad660adce8be765e00b.jpg

Firstly - the game is now being handled by Crunching Koalas, a publishing studio responsible for porting and bringing BUTCHER to consoles. The guys at Transhuman Design were pretty happy about our work, so they decided to trust us even more and hand the PC version of the game over to us. Not much will change, maybe besides you seeing BUTCHER more often, but if you ever wanted to contact us about the game, feel free to:
post your messages on BUTCHER's community hub
send us e-mails
ping us at Twitter or Facebook

Secondly - we decided to update the game and add some new languages! Our fast-paced blood-soaked love letter to the classics of the genre is now available in:
German
French
Spanish
Portuguese
To celebrate the update, we also decided to cut the price of the game in half, for the next 7 days, so don't hesitate and get it right now!

Cheers,
Crunching Koalas

notes.title: Demo released - prepare for FREE BUTCHERing!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/18f97fcb8f7942c86555457218d8f49aafbf5447.jpg

The full version's campaign has been enhanced and the free demo - released!

Like promised before, we've added a pack of 3 levels to enhance the beginning of the game.

Those levels will be released for free as a standalone Demo (for those, who are still undecided).

https://store.steampowered.com/app/629260/

All 3 levels happen on the Mothership and take place just before the game intro. We've put some details here and there that might help you reveal what Mothership and her spawns really are.

If you already own BUTCHER and have some progress going on, we recommend starting the campaign in another (temporary) save slot. Alternatively, you can just play the levels one-by-one from the level browser.

If you don't own BUTCHER, you can download the free Demo and enjoy ripping and tearing your targets apart (slowly enough to make sure they experience their last moments to the fullest).

If you like the game and decide to support us, you have a chance to buy it for 50% of the regular price (a week-long sale is still running!) ːbutcherchainsawː

Have fun!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/4a0812c172bb98e10f759a6d703e90e22fda6fff.png

DRM-free demo mirrors: http://www.indiedb.com/games/butcher (will be updated on GOG and other stores as well, but it'll take more time)

notes.title: What's up? We made a gig.
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/cf510c9747e844f13645ffee1658b72015a4834e.jpg

We had a really great but busy time before we were able to take some vacation.

We worked really hard to give an experimental game music concert with music improvised to the game played in the real time. It was one of the Pixel Heaven 2017 afterparty gigs. We wanted to stream it and publish some official recordings. However, the local staff had some technical problems rendering some of our plans impossible to realize. 

Fortunately, some of our gamedev friends recorded parts of the gig for us! Enjoy:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s9DWzGA5FpA
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ck0XkIXdkb0

Members of the band:
Maciej Niedzielski (musician) - that bearded guy playing the piano
Krzysztof Chomicki (level designer) - that bearded guy playing the bass
Sebastian Krośkiewicz (me) (game designer) - that bearded guy playing the game (you can't see me in the videos)

Yes, we're all bearded, but they say beards are manly.

Despite having technical problems mentioned before (no recordings, delays, allowed to play only 13 minutes out of planned 30 etc.), we're happy that we managed to actually do all of this (it was my first time organizing a concert, yay!). Who knows, maybe we'll even do something similar in the future.

Demo version (already available in the Beta branch)
We're also releasing BUTCHER's demo version soon. Not because it's gonna be particularly profitable, but simply because we want to do it. It's ready to be tested in the Beta branch (it requires you to start the game again or play the levels one-by-one in the level browser).

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/4a0812c172bb98e10f759a6d703e90e22fda6fff.png

The demo will offer 3 new levels and some new music. It takes place before the events of the main game. You start aboard the Mothership and take some calibration tests before you're allowed to go on your mission and seek your real targets.

We still need to fix some minor issues and do some tweaks, so we're waiting for your feedback!

Console releases

Thanks to Crunching Koalas, the game is also available on PS4 and XBox One! The list of consoles we support might grow in the future, but we can't tell you anything about that yet.

Also, prepare for Summer Sale starting in a few hours. Let's hope it will bring a little more gamers who like torturing pixel people as much as we do.

Remember about the level editor!

We want to play some levels made by you too! If they're really good, maybe we'll add them to the official collection as free DLCs (giving you a credit for that).

notes.title: Gamepad config fixes (and Discord server)
notes.content:
Gamepad config fixes

If you had to reconfigure the gamepad all the time because the game used to mess up your bindings, we gladly announce that this annoying issue should be fixed now.

You only need to rebind your buttons one last time to get rid of the faulty values in your config file, then you should be good to go. Of course, make sure Steam updates the game first ːmurdererː

The bug manifested itself only if you used X, Y, A or B in gamepad config (excluding the initial default setting).

notes.title: BUTCHER W.I.M.P. (EASY MODE) DLC RELEASE
notes.content:
Do you feel overly frustrated with BUTCHER and just want to murder like a tank?

We've got a surprise for you!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/46ae2ea7deb5a59e824842f79de9973b92f1251d.png

BUTCHER W.I.M.P. (Winning Is My Pleasure) is an easy mode DLC that will allow you beat levels only for the price of losing your dignity (if you have no dignity already, you lose nothing!).

[strike]Also, BUTCHER is 20% OFF on that occasion![/strike] (special offer ended)

Warning! Side effects might include:

Depression
Lower self-esteem
Socially inappropriate behavior caused by the loss of self-respect
Feeling offended
Sleep disorders


Also, we've recently added the following features:

Better gamepad support (especially XBox and DS4 on Windows)
Key combo support in controls settings
Scoreboards for speedrun high-scores
Multiple save files

notes.title: Gamepad testing, pt. 2
notes.content:
If you want to test gamepads (and leaderboards), switch to the beta branch (passphrase: "idontmindbugsinthisbranch"). 

Progress:

Tweaked combo keys support - possibility to assign multiple actions to a single key (useful if you want to have walking and aiming on the same stick)
Possibility to tweak walking and jumping deadzones in the settings
Possibility to have a different buttons/axes for swimming (gamepad-exclusive)
Improved auto-aim (can switch targets, slightly compensates the target speed)
Aiming is not forced to be on a circle around the player anymore, you can move the crosshair freely inside of it, which should feel more precise
No "select keyboard layout" popup if gamepad is used in-game


Minor fixes:

 Mouse cursor is not clipped to the window in pause menu anymore.
 The leaderboard's histogram of scores should display player's percentile correctly even if the histogram is not yet updated (updates every hour)


Tested gamepads:
We were able to test the the following configurations (and they should work out of box):

 Windows 7: XBox 360, XBox One, DS4
 Linux (Ubuntu 16.04, default xbox driver): XBox 360 wireless (the wired one will require rebind in advanced settings)
 OSX (tested by @Khalosh): Logitech XBox 360-like gamepad


Other configurations and systems might work, but no guarantees. Unfortunately, there's no way to test it on our side. Most official Microsoft and Sony gamepads should work (possibly after some reconfiguration, especially on non-Windows systems). Some cheap third party gamepads might work too, but we can't offer any support with them.

Have fun ripping and tearing your wrists and thumbs. In case of extreme frustration, remember that gamepads seem to be pretty good warhammers against monitors.

Also, we're preparing something funny (at least to us), but I won't tell anything more yet.

notes.title: Gamepad testing
notes.content:
We're working on better gamepad support, which is accessible in the beta branch (passphrase: "idontmindbugsinthisbranch").

I don't want to post it as an update yet, because of too little visible changes.

What it introduces:

Combo keys (also for keyboard users)
Rebindable gamepad layout (similar to keyboard layout)
Slight auto-aim
More abstract way of expressing buttons of known gamepads (LEFTSTICK instead of JOYSTICKBUTTON9 for example, only in non-advanced menu)
The "Gamepad (experimental)" renamed to "Gamepad (advanced)"
Ability to turn off gamepad support in menu in case of non-supported gamepads messing with menu navigation (so you can plug it in and set it up properly)


Supported and tested gamepads:
Windows: XBox One, XBox 360, DS4

Other pads on other systems might work, but will likely require some tweaking in advanced options.

The gamepad bindings are saved (if different than default) in:
[game folder]\butcher_Data\StreamingAssets\Game\Joysticks, so it's possible to share them.

Known issues:

Can't unbind the right stick from aiming yet (possible if you edit config file, I can tell you how to do it if you need it)
"Use gamepad in-game" checkbox is still in "Gamepad (Advanced)", should be in "Gamepad" menu


I'm not a gamepad player myself, so I still find the style harder than mouse + keyboard and I can't probably judge whether it's good enough or still needs tweaks (I can play the game on "the hardest" difficulty without that many problems though). It would be awesome if you could give me some feedback :)

notes.title: Bugfixes and more...
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new small update!

Changes:

Added: an option to clean-up all gore each time you respawn (Settings -> Video).
Fixed: smoke effects are now below the player and enemies to improve readability.
Fixed: not working skull achievements.
Fixed: being able to go outside of the map in jungle, level 1.
Fixed: railgun ignored picking up ammo when charged.
Fixed: grenades (and likely other window-breaking projectiles) could tunnel through wall if shot through overlapping breakable window.
Fixed: level browser menu impossible to navigate with gamepad.
Fixed: slight sound tweaks here and there.


In other words, nothing should hinder you from squeezing the last drop of blood and feces out of your screaming enemies.

notes.title: Small Butcher update
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback and people streaming the game, we were able to prepare a small update that makes the game a bit more friendly towards newbies:


Added more places to hide, more ammo packs and balanced the number of more difficult enemies in Ironworks Facility levels.
Added options to turn off HUD health feedback (hurt noise and low HP warning overlay) for people who don't like it


Make sure Steam updates the game on your machine and have fun making your enemies drown in their own blood before they bleed to death.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26094784/e8e1f391355234230b7d4dd927457592a813c786.jpg
